datums.C: 3× Ø16 wells on Ø44 PCD at 120° (tertiary). Even platter.

fits_mm.location_bushing_seat: +0.40 diametral (Ø14.0 / Ø14.4) with a 2 mm land in the keeper
fits_mm.centering_cone: 0.20 radial at the cup mouth (male r 4.8 in female r 5.0)
fits_mm.axial_thrust_and_cap: 0.20 float — running faces do not occupy the same volume

gdt.position: Pocket pattern positional Ø0.4 MMC to B (one nozzle). FDM cannot hold tighter without a gauge print.

lessons.title: Clearance is a design input
lessons.teach: A 0.4 mm Bambu nozzle cannot hold CNC fits. Model +0.40 mm diametral clearance in CAD for every printed-to-printed running or slip interface. Leave slicer XY hole compensation at 0 unless a gauge print says otherwise.

lessons.title: No FDM press fits
lessons.teach: Press fits fail from elephant foot and shrinkage. Use +0.40 slip and retain with a shoulder, land, keeper, or cap. Do not assume a metal bearing will appear later.

lessons.title: Build a product, not a cage
lessons.teach: The platter is the part. The foot is smaller than the platter. The keeper is a small collar on the journal — not a second Ø90 lid. The hub sits on the shoulder. Running faces have modeled gaps. Assembly order: base → shaft → platter → keeper → bushing → cap.

lessons.title: Print a thrust bearing that can actually spin
lessons.teach: A lifted same-angle cone never touches (parallel surfaces). Center with a 45° cup and a smaller male cone, and take thrust on a narrow annular land with 0.20 mm float. Relief under the apex so the tip does not bottom.

lessons.title: Keep the machine even
lessons.teach: Three wells at 120° on the platter and a double-D so the platter turns the shaft. An odd one-sided vane is not a turntable.

lessons.title: Print the bearings too
lessons.teach: Printed cone + land for thrust, printed sleeve in a shouldered keeper for radial. Keeper thicker than the bushing so the seat has a land. Metal 608 / catalog bearings are a later table, not a hidden part.

lessons.title: The platter is a part that mounts
lessons.teach: A lone C-loft coupon is not a product. The turntable platter sits on the shaft shoulder, carries three even wells and a rim, and is driven by a double-D.

lessons.title: Export a printable package
lessons.teach: Assign appearances, run solid_export_preflight, then solid_export_3mf for bambu_studio. Print each body in its own orientation (base/platter/keeper flat, shaft on the land, bushing as a ring). 3MF is the manufacturing handoff.
